name: hostcompat
description: The shared host-compat scenario: one template for every host, filled from that host's override.json (internal/hostcompat/template.go, design doc Amendment 7b). It asserts only that Stagehand can connect, enumerate, see a subwindow, deliver input, capture a frame and survive. It never asserts that the host behaves correctly. Every action must pass the internal/hostcompat surface allowlist; a step a host needs that is missing here belongs HERE, not in the override.

steps.name: enumerate: the host's main scene is in the tree
enumerate: the clickable node is visible to Stagehand
subwindow: Stagehand sees Window nodes (/root plus the host's own)
input: let the host process the event
survive: the host's main scene is still in the tree
capture: a frame of the host
